connector.name: Canvas Lms MCP
connector.registryDescription: TypeScript MCP server for Canvas LMS - 115 read+write tools across 17 domains.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package canvas-lms-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bruchris account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CANVAS_API_TOKEN
env.description: Canvas personal access token (Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → New Access Token)

env.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
env.description: Canvas instance API URL, e.g. https://school.instructure.com/api/v1
